items.title: 'Slopfix': A software team is charging up to $10,000 to clean up AI-generated code, with the help of *checks notes* AI
items.excerpt: A software team is charging up to $10,000 to 'fix' broken vibe-coded projects — using AI to clean up AI-generated code. A pointed snapshot of where the vibe-coding boom lands for small studios and solo devs: 'who fixes the fixes?'

items.title: From prompt to reality: how to turn your idea into a physical 3D-printed collectible using Hi3D
items.excerpt: 80 Level put Hi3D's AI 3D-maker platform through a full pipeline test: from a single text prompt to concept variations, watertight auto-repaired meshes, and a fully assembled, print-ready Space Marine miniature — a working text-to-physical-collectible workflow for game artists. (Re-offered: fresh and uncovered from 7/8 pool.)

items.title: Set up and debug faster with Unity AI
items.excerpt: Official Unity video shows Unity AI (Beta) setting up and debugging animation state machines, behavior trees, and transitions from prompts 'so you can focus on game feel' — a third pillar of the Unity AI workflow after the asset-audit (7/7 card) and scene-setup (7/8 card) demos. Note outlet overlap: Unity (YouTube) had cards on 7/7 and 7/8.

items.title: DOOM: The Dark Ages | Revelations Launches Today Including DLSS Multi Frame Generation & Path Tracing
items.excerpt: id Software's DOOM: The Dark Ages expansion Revelations ships with neural rendering across the board — DLSS Multi Frame Generation up to 6X, Super Resolution, and path tracing with Ray Reconstruction (up to 310 fps at 4K on RTX 5090); Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced follows July 9. Published time from on-page date (July 7, 2026); no article:published_time meta on nvidia.com.
